cues: Give columnar cells cilia, and the beating hairs sweep things along: mucus in the bronchioles, the egg along the oviduct, cerebrospinal fluid in the brain's ventricles.
text: Give columnar cells cilia, and the beating hairs sweep things along: mucus in the bronchioles, the egg along the oviduct, cerebrospinal fluid in the brain's ventricles. That is ciliated columnar epithelium.
